translations.literal: First year of Xianfeng, xinhai
translations.idiomatic: First year of Xianfeng (1851), xinhai

translations.literal: Fifth month, yisi day, transferred. Left Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: On the fifth month, yisi day, transferred to Left Censor-in-Chief.

translations.literal: Second year of Xianfeng, renzi
translations.idiomatic: Second year of Xianfeng (1852), renzi

sentences.zh: 十月丙午遷。理藩院右侍郎。

translations.literal: Tenth month, bingwu day, transferred. Right Vice Minister of the Court of Colonial Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On the tenth month, bingwu day, transferred to Right Vice Minister of the Court of Colonial Affairs.

sentences.zh: 九月己酉乞養。十一月辛未左副都御史。

translations.literal: Ninth month, jiyou day, requested leave to care for parents. Eleventh month, xinwei day, Left Vice Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: On the ninth month, jiyou day, he requested leave to care for his parents; on the eleventh month, xinwei day, he was appointed Left Vice Censor-in-Chief.

translations.literal: Third year of Xianfeng, guichou
translations.idiomatic: Third year of Xianfeng (1853), guichou

sentences.zh: 三月壬子卒。理藩院尚書。九月庚戌革。癸丑理藩院尚書。

translations.literal: Third month, renzi day, died. Minister of the Court of Colonial Affairs. Ninth month, gengxu day, removed. Guichou day, Minister of the Court of Colonial Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On the third month, renzi day, he died in office as Minister of the Court of Colonial Affairs; on the ninth month, gengxu day, the post was vacated; on guichou day a new Minister of the Court of Colonial Affairs was appointed.

translations.literal: Ninth month, dingwei day, transferred. Left Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: On the ninth month, dingwei day, transferred to Left Censor-in-Chief.

sentences.zh: 降。三月甲戌左副都御史。九月丁未遷。十一月辛亥左副都御史。

translations.literal: Demoted. Third month, jiaxu day, Left Vice Censor-in-Chief. Ninth month, dingwei day, transferred. Eleventh month, xinhai day, Left Vice Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: He was demoted; on the third month, jiaxu day, appointed Left Vice Censor-in-Chief; on the ninth month, dingwei day, transferred out; on the eleventh month, xinhai day, appointed Left Vice Censor-in-Chief again.

sentences.zh: 十月戊子遷。十二月丙子左副都御史。

translations.literal: Tenth month, wuzi day, transferred. Twelfth month, bingzi day, Left Vice Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: On the tenth month, wuzi day, transferred out; on the twelfth month, bingzi day, appointed Left Vice Censor-in-Chief.

sentences.zh: 二月甲申遷。左副都御史。五月辛酉遷。左副都御史。十一月己酉遷。十二月乙酉左副都御史。丙申遷。

translations.literal: Second month, jiashen day, transferred. Left Vice Censor-in-Chief. Fifth month, xinyou day, transferred. Left Vice Censor-in-Chief. Eleventh month, jiyou day, transferred. Twelfth month, yiyou day, Left Vice Censor-in-Chief. Bingshen day, transferred.
translations.idiomatic: On the second month, jiashen day, transferred out; appointed Left Vice Censor-in-Chief; on the fifth month, xinyou day, transferred out again; on the eleventh month, jiyou day, transferred out; on the twelfth month, yiyou day, appointed Left Vice Censor-in-Chief; on bingshen day, transferred out.

translations.literal: Fourth year of Xianfeng, jiayin
translations.idiomatic: Fourth year of Xianfeng (1854), jiayin

sentences.zh: 正月戊申遷。理藩院右侍郎。

translations.literal: First month, wushen day, transferred. Right Vice Minister of the Court of Colonial Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On the first month, wushen day, transferred to Right Vice Minister of the Court of Colonial Affairs.

sentences.zh: 二月己卯遷。左都御史。十一月庚寅遷。左都御史。

translations.literal: Second month, jimao day, transferred. Left Censor-in-Chief. Eleventh month, gengyin day, transferred. Left Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: On the second month, jimao day, transferred to Left Censor-in-Chief; on the eleventh month, gengyin day, transferred to Left Censor-in-Chief.

sentences.zh: 十月遷。左副都御史。十二月遷。

translations.literal: Tenth month, transferred. Left Vice Censor-in-Chief. Twelfth month, transferred.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month, transferred out after serving as Left Vice Censor-in-Chief; in the twelfth month, transferred out.

sentences.zh: 三月遷。五月庚戌左副都御史。

translations.literal: Third month, transferred. Fifth month, gengxu day, Left Vice Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, transferred out; on the fifth month, gengxu day, appointed Left Vice Censor-in-Chief.

sentences.zh: 三月癸未副都御史。三月辛亥遷。四月辛巳左副都御史。

translations.literal: Third month, guiwei day, Vice Censor-in-Chief. Third month, xinhai day, transferred. Fourth month, xinsi day, Left Vice Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: On the third month, guiwei day, appointed Vice Censor-in-Chief; on the third month, xinhai day, transferred out; on the fourth month, xinsi day, appointed Left Vice Censor-in-Chief.

translations.literal: Fifth year of Xianfeng, yimao
translations.idiomatic: Fifth year of Xianfeng (1855), yimao

sentences.zh: 九月乙丑遷。理藩院尚書。

translations.literal: Ninth month, yichou day, transferred. Minister of the Court of Colonial Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On the ninth month, yichou day, transferred to Minister of the Court of Colonial Affairs.

sentences.zh: 遷。五月乙亥理藩院左侍郎。

translations.literal: Transferred. Fifth month, yihai day, Left Vice Minister of the Court of Colonial Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Transferred out; on the fifth month, yihai day, appointed Left Vice Minister of the Court of Colonial Affairs.

translations.literal: Ninth month, yichou day, transferred. Left Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: On the ninth month, yichou day, transferred to Left Censor-in-Chief.

sentences.zh: 正月丁亥休。三月丙子左副都御史。六月辛亥遷。八月甲午左副都御史。

translations.literal: First month, dinghai day, granted retirement leave. Third month, bingzi day, Left Vice Censor-in-Chief. Sixth month, xinhai day, transferred. Eighth month, jiawu day, Left Vice Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: On the first month, dinghai day, granted retirement leave; on the third month, bingzi day, appointed Left Vice Censor-in-Chief; on the sixth month, xinhai day, transferred out; on the eighth month, jiawu day, appointed Left Vice Censor-in-Chief.

translations.literal: Third month, Left Vice Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, appointed Left Vice Censor-in-Chief.

sentences.zh: 四月革。五月乙亥左副都御史。

translations.literal: Fourth month, removed. Fifth month, yihai day, Left Vice Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month, removed from office; on the fifth month, yihai day, appointed Left Vice Censor-in-Chief.

translations.literal: Sixth year of Xianfeng, bingchen
translations.idiomatic: Sixth year of Xianfeng (1856), bingchen

sentences.zh: 十一月乙卯遷。左都御史。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, yimao day, transferred. Left Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: On the eleventh month, yimao day, transferred to Left Censor-in-Chief.

sentences.zh: 十月遷。十二月左副都御史。

translations.literal: Tenth month, transferred. Twelfth month, Left Vice Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month, transferred out; in the twelfth month, appointed Left Vice Censor-in-Chief.

sentences.zh: 八月戊子遷。九月戊寅左副都御史。

translations.literal: Eighth month, wuzi day, transferred. Ninth month, wuyin day, Left Vice Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: On the eighth month, wuzi day, transferred out; on the ninth month, wuyin day, appointed Left Vice Censor-in-Chief.

translations.literal: Seventh year of Xianfeng, dingsi
translations.idiomatic: Seventh year of Xianfeng (1857), dingsi

sentences.zh: 七月甲申解任。乙酉理藩院尚書。八月甲子病免。理藩院尚書。

translations.literal: Seventh month, jiashen day, relieved of office. Yiyou day, Minister of the Court of Colonial Affairs. Eighth month, jiazi day, dismissed due to illness. Minister of the Court of Colonial Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On the seventh month, jiashen day, relieved of office; on yiyou day, appointed Minister of the Court of Colonial Affairs; on the eighth month, jiazi day, dismissed due to illness while serving as Minister of the Court of Colonial Affairs.

sentences.zh: 二月戊申遷。理藩院左侍郎。

translations.literal: Second month, wushen day, transferred. Left Vice Minister of the Court of Colonial Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On the second month, wushen day, transferred to Left Vice Minister of the Court of Colonial Affairs.

sentences.zh: 二月戊申遷。理藩院右侍郎。十月壬申遷。理藩院右侍郎。

translations.literal: Second month, wushen day, transferred. Right Vice Minister of the Court of Colonial Affairs. Tenth month, renshen day, transferred. Right Vice Minister of the Court of Colonial Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On the second month, wushen day, transferred to Right Vice Minister of the Court of Colonial Affairs; on the tenth month, renshen day, transferred to Right Vice Minister of the Court of Colonial Affairs.

sentences.zh: 正月戊辰遷。左都御史。八月甲子遷。左都御史。

translations.literal: First month, wuchen day, transferred. Left Censor-in-Chief. Eighth month, jiazi day, transferred. Left Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: On the first month, wuchen day, transferred to Left Censor-in-Chief; on the eighth month, jiazi day, transferred to Left Censor-in-Chief.

translations.literal: Fourth month, jiyou day, Left Vice Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: On the fourth month, jiyou day, appointed Left Vice Censor-in-Chief.

translations.literal: Fourth month, Left Vice Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month, appointed Left Vice Censor-in-Chief.

sentences.zh: 正月丙子免。四月己酉左副都御史。

translations.literal: First month, bingzi day, dismissed. Fourth month, jiyou day, Left Vice Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: On the first month, bingzi day, dismissed from office; on the fourth month, jiyou day, appointed Left Vice Censor-in-Chief.

translations.literal: Eighth year of Xianfeng, wuwu
translations.idiomatic: Eighth year of Xianfeng (1858), wuwu

sentences.zh: 九月壬午遷。理藩院尚書。十二月庚午遷。理藩院尚書。

translations.literal: Ninth month, renwu day, transferred. Minister of the Court of Colonial Affairs. Twelfth month, gengwu day, transferred. Minister of the Court of Colonial Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On the ninth month, renwu day, transferred to Minister of the Court of Colonial Affairs; on the twelfth month, gengwu day, transferred to Minister of the Court of Colonial Affairs.

sentences.zh: 六月乙丑遷。理藩院右侍郎。

translations.literal: Sixth month, yichou day, transferred. Right Vice Minister of the Court of Colonial Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On the sixth month, yichou day, transferred to Right Vice Minister of the Court of Colonial Affairs.

translations.literal: Ninth month, renwu day, transferred. Left Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: On the ninth month, renwu day, transferred to Left Censor-in-Chief.

sentences.zh: 十一月己卯遷。庚辰左都御史。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, jimao day, transferred. Gengchen day, Left Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: On the eleventh month, jimao day, transferred out; on gengchen day, appointed Left Censor-in-Chief.

sentences.zh: 六月遷。九月甲午左副都御史。

translations.literal: Sixth month, transferred. Ninth month, jiawu day, Left Vice Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, transferred out; on the ninth month, jiawu day, appointed Left Vice Censor-in-Chief.

sentences.zh: 十月免。十二月甲寅左副都御史。

translations.literal: Tenth month, dismissed. Twelfth month, jiayin day, Left Vice Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month, dismissed from office; on the twelfth month, jiayin day, appointed Left Vice Censor-in-Chief.

translations.literal: Ninth year of Xianfeng, jiwei
translations.idiomatic: Ninth year of Xianfeng (1859), jiwei

sentences.zh: 十二月壬寅遷。理藩院尚書。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, renyin day, transferred. Minister of the Court of Colonial Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On the twelfth month, renyin day, transferred to Minister of the Court of Colonial Affairs.

sentences.zh: 十二月壬寅遷。理藩院左侍郎。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, renyin day, transferred. Left Vice Minister of the Court of Colonial Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On the twelfth month, renyin day, transferred to Left Vice Minister of the Court of Colonial Affairs.

sentences.zh: 六月壬子遷。理藩院右侍郎。

translations.literal: Sixth month, renzi day, transferred. Right Vice Minister of the Court of Colonial Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On the sixth month, renzi day, transferred to Right Vice Minister of the Court of Colonial Affairs.

translations.literal: Fifth month, jiawu day, transferred. Left Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: On the fifth month, jiawu day, transferred to Left Censor-in-Chief.

sentences.zh: 二月甲辰遷。五月己丑左副都御史。九月戊子遷。十一月左副都御史。

translations.literal: Second month, jiachen day, transferred. Fifth month, jichou day, Left Vice Censor-in-Chief. Ninth month, wuzi day, transferred. Eleventh month, Left Vice Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: On the second month, jiachen day, transferred out; on the fifth month, jichou day, appointed Left Vice Censor-in-Chief; on the ninth month, wuzi day, transferred out; in the eleventh month, appointed Left Vice Censor-in-Chief.

sentences.zh: 五月甲午遷。十月甲辰左副都御史。

translations.literal: Fifth month, jiawu day, transferred. Tenth month, jiachen day, Left Vice Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: On the fifth month, jiawu day, transferred out; on the tenth month, jiachen day, appointed Left Vice Censor-in-Chief.

sentences.zh: 三月辛卯遷。五月己丑左副都御史。

translations.literal: Third month, xinmao day, transferred. Fifth month, jichou day, Left Vice Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: On the third month, xinmao day, transferred out; on the fifth month, jichou day, appointed Left Vice Censor-in-Chief.

translations.literal: Tenth year of Xianfeng, gengshen
translations.idiomatic: Tenth year of Xianfeng (1860), gengshen

sentences.zh: 二月己未遷。理藩院尚書。六月乙亥遷。理藩院尚書。

translations.literal: Second month, jiwei day, transferred. Minister of the Court of Colonial Affairs. Sixth month, yihai day, transferred. Minister of the Court of Colonial Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On the second month, jiwei day, transferred to Minister of the Court of Colonial Affairs; on the sixth month, yihai day, transferred to Minister of the Court of Colonial Affairs.

translations.literal: Fifth month, dingyou day, transferred. Left Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: On the fifth month, dingyou day, transferred to Left Censor-in-Chief.

translations.literal: Ninth month, guisi day, transferred. Left Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: On the ninth month, guisi day, transferred to Left Censor-in-Chief.

sentences.zh: 革。五月甲寅左副都御史。十二月丙戌遷。

translations.literal: Removed. Fifth month, jiayin day, Left Vice Censor-in-Chief. Twelfth month, bingxu day, transferred.
translations.idiomatic: Removed from office; on the fifth month, jiayin day, appointed Left Vice Censor-in-Chief; on the twelfth month, bingxu day, transferred out.

sentences.zh: 閏三月卒。十二月庚申左副都御史。

translations.literal: Intercalary third month, died. Twelfth month, gengshen day, Left Vice Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary third month, he died in office; on the twelfth month, gengshen day, appointed Left Vice Censor-in-Chief.

translations.literal: Eleventh year of Xianfeng, xinyou
translations.idiomatic: Eleventh year of Xianfeng (1861), xinyou

sentences.zh: 十月丙辰遷。左都御史。辛酉遷。左都御史。

translations.literal: Tenth month, bingchen day, transferred. Left Censor-in-Chief. Xinyou day, transferred. Left Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: On the tenth month, bingchen day, transferred to Left Censor-in-Chief; on xinyou day, transferred to Left Censor-in-Chief.

sentences.zh: 十月癸亥遷。甲子左都御史。十二月庚午遷。左都御史。

translations.literal: Tenth month, guihai day, transferred. Jiazi day, Left Censor-in-Chief. Twelfth month, gengwu day, transferred. Left Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: On the tenth month, guihai day, transferred out; on jiazi day, appointed Left Censor-in-Chief; on the twelfth month, gengwu day, transferred to Left Censor-in-Chief.

sentences.zh: 十月乙未革。十二月左副都御史。

translations.literal: Tenth month, yiwei day, removed. Twelfth month, Left Vice Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: On the tenth month, yiwei day, removed from office; in the twelfth month, appointed Left Vice Censor-in-Chief.

sentences.zh: 十一月遷。十二月左副都御史。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, transferred. Twelfth month, Left Vice Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, transferred out; in the twelfth month, appointed Left Vice Censor-in-Chief.

translations.literal: Second month, gengchen day, Left Vice Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: On the second month, gengchen day, appointed Left Vice Censor-in-Chief.
